verdict.rationale: Google's docs confirm both port types, offering Titan keys in USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC form factors (docs-13), and a community user mentions carrying keys on a keyring (comm-3). Nothing shows a low-profile nano model, and one user complains the key is "so big" and lacks a subtler form factor (comm-6), so the carry-style half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: a low-profile/nano form factor, explicit documentation of a keychain/lanyard design, independent corroboration of the current lineup.
